prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: layered photorealistic cat sprite for continuous skeletal animation.
Input is the exact character and standing body pose to preserve: adult stocky brown tabby, olive-green eyes, cream chin, dark ringed tail. Create a 2-column by 2-row transparent sprite sheet of four isolated components in four equal square cells with large gutters.
Top left: the SAME complete standing cat BODY, head, neck, chest, torso, tail and both hind legs, in exactly this three-quarter right-facing upright pose. REMOVE BOTH front legs entirely, naturally fill their shoulder/chest attachment areas with the matching continuous tabby fur. Preserve the two grounded hind feet, body silhouette, head direction, face and all markings. This is a torso asset which will have animated front legs layered onto it. Do not draw ANY forearm, wrist or front paw on this body asset.
Top right: ONLY one entire NEAR-SIDE front leg for this cat, isolated as a straight relaxed vertical limb, shoulder at top, elbow at center, rounded natural CAT PAW at bottom. Include fur overlap at top shoulder for clean rig attachment. About 120 units long and 30 units wide proportionally, correct matching thick adult tabby foreleg, same fur scale/light. No body, head or other limbs in this cell.
Bottom left: ONLY the FAR-SIDE front leg, same straight relaxed vertical component, shoulder top, elbow center, natural cat paw bottom; slightly slimmer/darker due to depth, but same cat. No body/head.
Bottom right: full original standing cat with both front legs in the input pose as identity checking reference; same size as top-left body, hind feet same place.
Output MUST be genuinely transparent, photorealistic soft fur, no background, grid, text, labels, shadows, board or extra objects. Never human hands or fingers. All components completely uncropped and separated from neighboring cells. The body without front legs and the two isolated limbs are for actual continuously bending/alternating claw strokes rather than different whole-cat stills.
